subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept redacted pre-fix xAI production logs plus positive/negative unit coverage as sufficient proof for this non-inducible provider-side rotation, or require an organic after-fix Grok gateway recovery log before merge?
rationale: ClawSweeper's external-PR gate normally requires after-fix real behavior proof, but the author credibly explains that xAI's code-less decrypt 400 only appears after provider-owned snapshot/key rotation and cannot be induced on demand without testing a different error path.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: Treat the pre-fix production logs plus focused predicate tests as sufficient for this specific non-inducible provider rotation, then land after rebase and exact-head checks stay green.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix logs
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until xAI naturally emits the code-less decrypt error again and the contributor attaches redacted gateway logs showing the sanitized retry succeeds.

options.title: Ask for an alternate harness
options.body: Request a loopback/OpenAI-SDK harness proving the outgoing retry payload shape while acknowledging it cannot prove the real xAI rotation trigger.

recommendation.title: Accept a proof override
recommendation.body: Treat the pre-fix production logs plus focused predicate tests as sufficient for this specific non-inducible provider rotation, then land after rebase and exact-head checks stay green.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent merged retry behavior in the same predicate and are the clearest history-backed owner for deciding proof sufficiency here.
